concerns.text: The Summary states the system 'ingests abstracts from ML and non-ML domains' and the FR-001 row says T011 implements 'download, pagination, balancing, fallback logic' against a primary source, but research.md §2 establishes that NO verified abstract corpus (ML or non-ML, with acceptance labels) exists in the verified-datasets block — only pre-computed MiniLM embedding parquets. The plan should state in its own text (Summary or FR-001 row) that real-data acquisition is contingent on a verified source being added, with the deterministic fixture as the dry-run path, so the plan and research.md agree on data feasibility.
